# Name the clock first

`customer_support.pb.sla_management.name_the_clock_first` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **playbook**

> Before working a ticket, establish which clocks the entitlement actually created and which one this ticket will be judged on. Put that clock, and only that clock, in the view the agent works from.

Agents optimise whatever is displayed. If the queue shows resolution and the contract promises first response, the team will work the wrong deadline diligently and correctly, and no amount of coaching will fix a display problem.
